title: Workflow or Agent? A Decision Framework Before You Architect Anything
excerpt: Proposes four deciding questions: can the steps be enumerated in advance, how high is the blast radius of a wrong next step, how observable is the decision trace, and what is the unit economics at full volume. Introduces the 'earned autonomy' principle: default to a workflow first and promote to agent only after instrumentation shows a workflow cannot solve the case. Argues most production 'agents' are actually workflows that overshot their brief.
